ad_info.reference_style: Before/after testimonial ad with product on a stone pedestal and an editorial lower panel

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium editorial before/after: real phone-style photos of the same woman, clean blush lower panel, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Intimate, honest and aspirational; natural home light.
global_identity.graphic_language: Soft rounded pills, a wavy organic panel edge, thin vertical dividers, thin-line icons, a fuchsia highlight box behind the product name.
global_identity.text_typography: Elegant high-contrast serif for the testimonial quote; Poppins Bold for the highlighted product name; Poppins Regular for the icon labels and pills.

creative_objective: Tell a first-person story of the 'skinny friend' who finally got curves, with an obvious but natural gain in glute, hip and thigh volume between before and after, and anchor it to the bottle.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The before/after contrast of the same woman. 2) The testimonial quote. 3) The bottle on its pedestal. 4) The three icons.
art_direction.composition_style: Two vertical photos side by side across the full top, separated by a thin white line; a blush wavy panel rises from the bottom-left covering about the lower 40% of the left photo and the lower-left of the right photo; the after-woman's legs continue down on the right over the panel area.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Pills in the top corners; bottle in the bottom-left corner; quote centered in the lower middle; three icons in a row below the quote with thin dividers.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Cool flat indoor light in the before; warm flattering light in the after; soft shadow under the bottle on the stone.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top: two vertical photos side by side split by a thin white vertical line. Left photo: a mirror selfie of a slim woman in a bedroom (bed in the background), phone in hand, with a cream rounded pill 'ANTES' in the top-left. Right photo: the same woman posing confidently in a fitted outfit, holding the product up near her shoulder, against a plain warm wall, with a rounded pill 'DESPUÉS' in the top-right. Bottom-left corner: the product standing on a rough natural stone pedestal with green leaves behind. A light wavy panel with an organic top edge covers the lower-left part of the image; on it, a two-line serif quote, a line naming the product with a highlight box behind the product name, and a row of three thin-line icons with two-line labels separated by thin vertical dividers. The after-woman's legs continue on the right side down to the bottom.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 before/after testimonial ad. TOP: two vertical photos side by side, separated by a thin white vertical line, both showing the SAME ultra-photorealistic Latina woman in her mid-20s (same face, long straight dark hair, same tattoos-free skin, same height). LEFT PHOTO (BEFORE): a phone mirror selfie in a simple bedroom with an unmade white bed behind, cool flat indoor light, her body turned 3/4 to the side; she wears a black ribbed crop top and loose gray cotton short shorts; her glutes are flat, her hips narrow and her thighs thin. A pale blush (#FBE3EE) rounded pill in the top-left corner with deep magenta (#B0105E) uppercase text 'ANTES'. RIGHT PHOTO (AFTER), occupying the full height of the right half: the same woman standing in a confident 3/4 side pose against a plain warm beige wall (no logos, no emblems), warm flattering light, wearing a fitted black top and very short fitted fuchsia (#E6177F) shorts, holding the product up near her shoulder with one hand; her glutes are now clearly fuller, rounder and lifted, her hips wider and her thighs thicker and toned, an obvious volume gain yet natural and believable, the glute-and-thigh area clearly visible. A pale blush rounded pill in the top-right corner with deep magenta uppercase text 'DESPUÉS'. Maximum realism in both photos: real skin texture with visible pores, natural creases, subtle skin tone variation, realistic fabric folds, real smartphone/full-frame photo quality; no plastic or airbrushed skin; tasteful, non-explicit fashion styling. BOTTOM-LEFT CORNER: the product standing upright on a rough natural beige stone pedestal with a few green tropical leaves behind it. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS'. The same bottle appears small in the after-woman's hand. LOWER AREA: a pale blush (#FBE3EE) panel with a soft wavy organic top edge rises from the bottom-left and covers the lower part of the left photo and the lower-left of the right photo, leaving the after-woman's legs visible on the right. On the panel, to the right of the bottle: a two-line quote in an elegant high-contrast black serif, then a line in Poppins Regular black where the product name is set in Poppins Bold white inside a fuchsia (#E6177F) highlight box. Below, a row of three thin black line icons (a leaf, a curvy hips silhouette, a sparkle), each with a short two-line label in Poppins Regular, separated by thin vertical gray dividers. Include only these elements and texts.

mandatory_visual_elements: Two side-by-side photos of the same ultra-realistic woman separated by a thin white line
Before: bedroom mirror selfie, loose gray short shorts, flat glutes and thin thighs
After: confident 3/4 pose, very short fitted fuchsia shorts, holding the bottle, visibly fuller glutes, hips and thighs
Blush pills ANTES and DESPUÉS in the top corners
The real product bottle on a rough stone pedestal with green leaves in the bottom-left corner
Pale blush wavy panel holding the quote and the icon row
Fuchsia highlight box behind the product name
Three thin line icons separated by thin vertical dividers
final_generation_exclusions: No logo, emblem or decoration on the wall behind the after photo
No brand logos other than the label on the bottle; no other supplement brands or dropper bottles
No prices, CTA buttons, stars, ratings or badges
No cartoonish, exaggerated or surgical-looking body proportions; no nudity
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia), perfectly spelled with accents.
